caveat: MapBiomas pasture is treated as land dedicated to cattle grazing; EUDR's cattle commodity covers bovine livestock and products, so pasture land use is attributed to cattle even though the class does not itself record livestock presence.

Mixed/undifferentiated land-use mosaic (cropland, pasture and remnant vegetation combined at the mapping unit); cannot be attributed to a single Annex I commodity without finer-resolution data, so excluded from scope.
Direct one-to-one match with the EUDR soya (soybean) commodity.

Catch-all MapBiomas class for annual crops other than soy/rice/sugarcane/cotton (chiefly maize/corn and sorghum in this region); none of the crops it bundles are EUDR Annex I commodities, so excluded from scope.
